question: Who was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award for chess in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4 - D. Gúkesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **D. Gúkesh**, a young Indian chess prodigy, was awarded the prestigious **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** for his achievements in chess in **January 2025**.
 
• He became one of the youngest recipients of this award due to his remarkable performance in international chess tournaments and his contribution to promoting chess in India.
 
• Gúkesh has consistently outperformed his contemporaries, achieving the status of a **Grandmaster** at a very young age.
 
• In 2022, he entered the elite **2700 Elo rating club**, making him one of the youngest players globally to achieve this milestone.
 
• His victories in several international chess tournaments have brought India recognition on the global stage in this sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• It is the **highest sporting honor** in India, established in **1991-1992**.
 
• The award is named after **Major Dhyan Chand**, considered one of the greatest hockey players of all time.
 
• It recognizes athletes who have demonstrated exceptional performance and brought glory to India in their respective sports disciplines.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a **medal, certificate, and cash prize of ₹25 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **D. Gúkesh's Achievements:**
 
 
• Born on **May 29, 2006**, Gúkesh hails from **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, known as the chess hub of India.
 
• He became the **second youngest Grandmaster** in the history of chess at the age of **12 years, 7 months, and 17 days**.
 
• Gúkesh represented India in the **Chess Olympiad** and achieved exceptional results in the **2022 FIDE World Cup**.
 
• His aggressive playing style and strategic brilliance have earned him comparisons to chess legends like **Viswanathan Anand**.
 
 
 
• **Other Chess Players Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Vidit Gujrathi:** An Indian Grandmaster, known for his steady performances in global tournaments. He became a Grandmaster in **2013**.
 
• **Arjun Erigaisi:** Another young Indian chess player who has been making waves in international circuits. He became a Grandmaster at the age of **14**.
 
• **Viswanathan Anand:** A chess legend from India, the first Indian to win the **World Chess Championship**. He is a five-time world champion and recipient of the Khel Ratna Award.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Chess in India:**
 
 
• India has a rich history in chess, with the game originating in the country as **Chaturanga**.
 
• Indian players like **Viswanathan Anand** and the younger generation, including Gúkesh, have significantly contributed to popularizing chess.
 
• The government and chess federations have actively promoted the sport through initiatives, scholarships, and tournaments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility for Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• An athlete must exhibit consistent and exceptional performance at the **international level**.
 
• Achievements are evaluated over a four-year period prior to the year of the award.
 
 
 
• **Chess Olympiad 2022:**
 
 
• India hosted the **44th Chess Olympiad** in Chennai, marking a significant milestone in the sport's history in the country.
 
• Gúkesh was one of the standout performers, securing crucial victories for the Indian team.
